name: Ooty
description: Ooty (Udhagamandalam) is the premier hill station of South India, located at 2,240 meters in the Nilgiri Hills. Famous for its tea plantations, Eucalyptus forests, misty valleys, historic toy train, and serene lakes.

popularAttractions.name: Ooty Lake
popularAttractions.description: Artificial lake constructed in 1824 by John Sullivan, offering pedal boating and mini train rides.

popularAttractions.name: Doddabetta Peak
popularAttractions.description: Highest peak in the Nilgiris at 2,637 meters with a telescope house offering 360° views.

popularAttractions.name: Government Botanical Garden
popularAttractions.description: Lush 55-hectare terraced garden established in 1848 with rare species and fossil trees.

popularAttractions.name: Nilgiri Mountain Railway
popularAttractions.description: UNESCO World Heritage steam train winding through bridges and tunnels.

transportInfo.railway: Udhagamandalam Railway Station (Toy Train) / Mettupalayam (47 km)
transportInfo.bus: Ooty Central Bus Stand connecting Bengaluru, Mysuru, Chennai
transportInfo.road: Well connected via NH181 from Coimbatore / Mysuru

safetyInformation: Safe tourist destination. Drive cautiously on hairpin bends.

name: Munnar
description: Munnar is a breathtaking hill station in Kerala's Western Ghats surrounded by rolling tea estate hills, misty valleys, exotic flora, and waterfalls.

popularAttractions.name: Eravikulam National Park
popularAttractions.description: Home to the endangered Nilgiri Tahr mountain goat and Neelakurinji flower blooms.

popularAttractions.name: Mattupetty Dam
popularAttractions.description: Gravity dam nestled amidst tea gardens with speed boating and elephant viewing.

popularAttractions.name: Top Station
popularAttractions.description: Highest point in Munnar offering panoramic valley views over Tamil Nadu border.

transportInfo.railway: Aluva Railway Station (110 km) / Ernakulam (130 km)
transportInfo.bus: KSRTC Bus Depot Munnar connecting Kochi, Madurai, Coimbatore

safetyInformation: Safe hill station. Foggy conditions early morning and late evening.

name: Goa
description: Goa is India's pocket-sized paradise known for sun-kissed beaches, Portuguese colonial architecture, vibrant nightlife, spice plantations, and seafood.

popularAttractions.name: Fort Aguada
popularAttractions.description: 17th-century Portuguese fortress and lighthouse overlooking the Arabian Sea.

popularAttractions.name: Baga Beach
popularAttractions.description: Famous North Goa beach renowned for water sports, beach shacks, and night life.

popularAttractions.name: Dudhsagar Falls
popularAttractions.description: Four-tiered waterfall on Mandovi River cascading like a sea of white milk.

transportInfo.bus: Kadamba Bus Terminals at Panaji, Margao, Mapusa
transportInfo.road: Connected via NH66 from Mumbai and Mangaluru

safetyInformation: Follow beach safety flags and swimming advisories.

name: Manali
description: Manali is a high-altitude Himalayan resort town in Himachal Pradesh, famous for snow slopes, paragliding, Hadimba temple, Solang Valley, and Rohtang Pass.

popularAttractions.name: Hadimba Devi Temple
popularAttractions.description: 16th-century wooden pagoda cave temple in dense pine forests.

popularAttractions.name: Solang Valley
popularAttractions.description: World-famous adventure valley for paragliding, zorbing, and winter skiing.

popularAttractions.name: Rohtang Pass
popularAttractions.description: High mountain pass at 3,978m elevation on Pir Panjal Range.

transportInfo.railway: Chandigarh Railway Station (310 km) / Joginder Nagar (165 km)
transportInfo.bus: HRTC Volvo buses from Delhi (ISBT Kashmiri Gate) / Chandigarh
transportInfo.road: Connected via NH21 from Chandigarh and Delhi

safetyInformation: Check snow road clearances and weather alerts during winter.

name: Coorg
description: Coorg (Kodagu) is a rural district in Karnataka renowned for coffee plantations, spice gardens, misty waterfalls, river camps, and Kodava culture.

popularAttractions.name: Abbey Falls
popularAttractions.description: Cascading waterfall amidst coffee plantations viewed from hanging bridge.

popularAttractions.name: Raja's Seat
popularAttractions.description: Sunset viewpoint in Madikeri with manicured flower gardens.

popularAttractions.name: Dubare Elephant Camp
popularAttractions.description: Elephant camp on Kaveri riverbank offering bathing and feeding experiences.

transportInfo.airport: Kannur International Airport (90 km) / Mangaluru (140 km)
transportInfo.bus: KSRTC buses connecting Mysuru, Bengaluru, Mangaluru
transportInfo.road: Connected via State Highway 88 from Mysuru

safetyInformation: Safe rural hill region. Leech protection advised on rainforest treks during monsoon.
